about: The Command line page. {root} is replaced with the folder DE Tech Tool runs from. Every DE command here is tested; Windows commands are the ones DE technicians use on takeovers. Exit codes: 0 done, 1 not finished, 2 blocked or refused.

items.title: Open the window (asks for admin)
items.note: Double-clicking the file does the same.

items.title: Reopen after a restart at the queued step
items.note: Normally the resume task does this at sign-in.

items.title: Open on a page
items.note: Pages: Scan, Dashboard, Discovery, Identity, Security, Apps, Browser, Baseline, Branding, Network, Toolbox, Vendors, AiToolkit, Evidence, Settings.

items.title: Audit only, no window (changes nothing)
items.note: Writes the evidence bundle and a JSON result.

items.title: Plan a takeover without changing anything
items.note: Every step says what it would do.

items.title: Apply a takeover (changes the device)
items.note: Gates still stop anything unsafe; runtime secrets come from -PromptSecrets or RMM DE_SECRET_* variables.

items.title: Dropship first boot
items.note: Refuses a device other than the ordered serial.

items.title: Deploy or update from RMM (sha256-pinned)
items.note: Refuses a zip whose hash does not match.

items.title: Install the newest zip in Downloads
items.note: Unblocks, swaps the install folder safely, keeps the previous copy.

items.title: Check the package is untouched
items.note: FAIL lines name every changed file.

items.title: Install a licence from the Hub
items.note: Or Settings > Licence > Activate this device. A licence works only on the device it was issued for.

items.title: Show licence and build
items.command: Import-Module "{root}\console\modules\DE.Workflow\DE.Workflow.psm1"; Import-DEConsoleModules -Root "{root}\console"; $null = Initialize-DEConsole -Root "{root}\console" -Mode Audit; Get-DELicenseStatus; Get-DEBuildInfo

items.title: Plan a Toolbox script (changes nothing)
items.note: Every key is listed on the Toolbox page and below.

items.title: Run a Toolbox script for real
items.note: Output goes to the evidence folder as toolbox-*.log.

items.title: See the media build steps without running them
items.note: Needs the Windows ADK and WinPE add-on.

items.title: Write the rescue USB (erases it)
items.note: Use a second NTFS/exFAT USB for profile backups.

items.title: Watermarked release for a technician (test build)
items.note: Adds the build to packaging\out\build-register.csv.

items.title: Signed, enforced release
items.note: Licences required from this build on.

items.title: Dropship kit for an order
items.note: No secrets in the kit; first boot refuses any other device.

items.title: Install the Microsoft modules
items.note: Graph authentication, Exchange Online, Az.

items.title: Connect read-only plus BitLocker key IDs
items.note: Least-privilege scopes per scenario.

items.title: Is the BitLocker key in Entra for this device?
items.note: Key IDs only; the key itself is never requested.

items.title: Remove a device from Autopilot (plan first)
items.note: Drop -WhatIf to do it; refuses ambiguous serials.

items.title: Join state (Entra / AD / workplace)
items.note: AzureAdJoined, DomainJoined, DeviceId, TenantName.

items.title: Leave Entra ID (after the migration is verified and the BitLocker key is saved)
items.note: Then restart; dsregcmd /status must show AzureAdJoined : NO.

items.title: BitLocker recovery password and its ID
items.note: Match the Numerical Password ID with JumpCloud before leaving Entra.

items.title: Back up the key to Entra
items.command: $v = Get-BitLockerVolume C:; $p = $v.KeyProtector | Where-Object KeyProtectorType -eq RecoveryPassword; BackupToAAD-BitLockerKeyProtector -MountPoint C: -KeyProtectorId $p.KeyProtectorId
items.note: Only while the device is still Entra-joined.

items.title: Who is signed in, and profile owners
items.command: whoami /upn; Get-CimInstance Win32_UserProfile | Where-Object { -not $_.Special } | Select-Object LocalPath, SID, Loaded
items.note: S-1-12-1-... SIDs are Entra accounts.

items.title: Fix the clock
items.note: A wrong clock breaks HTTPS and sign-in.

items.title: Repair system files
items.note: Can take a long time.
